body:
| What | Path |
|---|---|
| **Actual code** | `/Volumes/D/www/projects/khanakia/chrome-extensions/filemark/` |
| Private docs + CLAUDE.md (source of truth) | `/Volumes/D/www/projects/khanakia/private-repo/markdown-viewer-chrome-ext/` |
| Those private docs symlinked into code repo via `repolink` | `filemark/CLAUDE.md` and `filemark/docsi/` |

The docs cwd contains **no code** — only planning / rules / problem
docs. Code edits belong in `filemark/`. A repolink-managed block in
`filemark/.gitignore` keeps the symlinks out of git history.

**Heuristic for new sessions:** if the cwd has no `package.json`,
you're in the docs dir; the code is in `chrome-extensions/filemark/`.
